models.label: ECMWF IFS 0.25°
models.note: ECMWF's operational physics model, open-data release. Its gust field is a maximum over the output interval, not an instantaneous value, so gust factors look large in light air.

models.label: ECMWF AIFS
models.note: ECMWF's machine-learning model - a genuinely independent opinion. Publishes no gust field, so gusts come from IFS and ICON-2i only.

models.label: ItaliaMeteo ICON-2i
models.note: ItaliaMeteo / ARPAE high-resolution model for Italy - the finest grid available here. Runs only ~60-72 h ahead and updates every 12 h, so it drops out of the longer-range view.

models.label: Météo-France MFWAM
models.note: Full sea-state decomposition - total wave, wind wave and swell with heights, directions and periods.

models.label: ECMWF WAM 0.25°
models.note: Total significant wave height only - used to cross-check MFWAM.

briefing.headline: Benign light-air pattern over the Aeolians now — but the forecast ends 30 Sep, four days short of our 3 Oct start.
briefing.synopsis: The consensus picture through 30 Sep is a slack, low-gradient regime: winds mostly 2-10 kt with no persistent direction, backing and veering between SE, SW and N from day to day, and total seas 0.3-1.8 ft at every island (ECMWF IFS 0.25°, 24 Sep 00Z; ECMWF AIFS, 24 Sep 06Z; ICON-2i, 24 Sep 00Z; wave data MFWAM and ECMWF WAM, both 24 Sep 00Z). The one organised signal is a northerly filling in from 26 Sep — Panarea 9.8 kt from N at 18:00, Stromboli 10.6 kt from N, Filicudi 10.1 kt from NNE at midday (ECMWF IFS 0.25°, 24 Sep 00Z). If that pattern held into the trip it would mean easy passage-making with the northern anchorages (San Pietro, Filicudi Porto, Marina Lunga) the ones to watch. Be clear, though: the models do not reach 4 Oct, so this is pattern context only, not a forecast for our dates.
briefing.overnight_anchorage: Tonight, 24 Sep, is a shore night — Portorosa Marina, scored fully sheltered as an enclosed basin, and the only option listed. Conditions there are as quiet as they get: 2.5 kt from ENE at 18:00 with 0.4 ft of sea, easing to 4.2 kt from S overnight (ECMWF IFS 0.25°, 24 Sep 00Z). Nothing in the payload would move a boat off the dock.
briefing.tomorrow_morning: Portorosa on 25 Sep shows 5.2 kt from SSW at 06:00 with 0.3 ft of sea, filling to about 6.9 kt from WNW by midday (ECMWF IFS 0.25°, 24 Sep 00Z). The rehearsal run of Portorosa → Lipari scores go on a 06:00 departure at 9.2 kt on a broad reach, with the note that it deteriorates after 11:00 — the standard early-start discipline we will use on the real trip. Note that the gust field spikes to 42.4 kt at Lipari and 37.1 kt at Salina at midday on 25 Sep: these are IFS interval-maximum gusts in near-calm air and should be read as model artefact, not a squall warning.

passage_notes.leg: Portorosa → Lipari (rehearsal 25 Sep, real date 4 Oct)
passage_notes.note: Rehearsal verdict go: 9.2 kt, broad reach, 06:00 start, deteriorating after 11:00.

passage_notes.leg: Lipari → Panarea (rehearsal 26 Sep, real date 5 Oct)
passage_notes.note: Rehearsal verdict go: 9.7 kt but head to wind — a motoring leg as modelled.

passage_notes.leg: Lipari → Stromboli, optional (rehearsal 27 Sep, real date 5 Oct)
passage_notes.note: Rehearsal verdict go: 10.0 kt head to wind, motor.

passage_notes.leg: Stromboli → Panarea, optional return (rehearsal 28 Sep, real date 6 Oct)
passage_notes.note: Rehearsal verdict go: 1.6 kt on a run — effectively calm; gusts to 7 kt are interval-maximum noise.

passage_notes.leg: Panarea → Filicudi (rehearsal 29 Sep, real date 7 Oct)
passage_notes.note: Rehearsal verdict go: 3.6 kt close reach — light, likely motor-sailing.

passage_notes.leg: Filicudi → Salina (rehearsal 30 Sep, real date 8 Oct)
passage_notes.note: Rehearsal verdict go: 4.6 kt broad reach. Last leg the models reach.

cautions: No model in the payload reaches 3 Oct — forecast horizon ends 30 Sep 23:00. Every "go" above is a rehearsal against this week's weather, not our trip.
Gust figures from ECMWF IFS are interval maxima, so the 42.4 kt at Lipari and 37.1 kt at Salina (25 Sep midday) against 8-9 kt means are artefacts of light air, not forecast squalls.
Models disagree at Lipari 25 Sep 18:00: range 0.8-7.8 kt. Small in absolute terms, but it shows direction and strength are poorly pinned even inside the horizon.

If the 26 Sep northerly pattern is representative of early October, San Pietro at Panarea (scored only workable with 10 kt NE straight in), Marina Lunga at Lipari and Filicudi Porto are the berths that would come under pressure; Drautto and Pecorini a Mare are the fallbacks.
briefing.confidence_note: Short-range agreement is good — mean run-to-run wind shift is 0.6 kt at 0-24 h and 1.3 kt at 72-120 h across 23 snapshots — but no model covers the trip dates at all, so confidence in anything for 3 Oct onward is effectively nil.
